title: Error bolus Calculator on latest dev 3.30 take IC /ISF on inexistent profiles Active
body:
I have only one profile named "FIASP" on nightscout and aaps latest dev.
When i launch the Bolus Calc, if i not select manually FIASP, takes value from not existent profile named Active, with IC and ISF different from mine.

No Autotune profiles, no DynamicISF active.

Pay attention, with this bug many people can rise BG or experiment dangerous low BG.

![photo_5881917511434354581_y](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/assets/39415490/a329be57-548d-4d84-8e1e-bd00a032b0aa)
![photo_5881917511434354583_y](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/assets/39415490/86eedee2-65bb-4c52-a90f-040e46a84812)
![photo_5881917511434354582_y](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/assets/39415490/e6abee0c-de70-4ad9-8d0f-9197825b6950)

There is no profile named _Active_ . I'm almost sur that the profile download from NS creates the bug.

In AAPS settings, stop all downloads **from** NS. Keep only the uploads **to** NS.

Create a new profile with a new name in AAPS. Manually, copy the settings from your _FIASP_ profile to the new one. Activate the new profile.

Delete the _FIASP_ profile.

Check if you stil have the bug (difference between _Actual_ and _New_ profile when you use the bolus calculator).

I also try this option.
Same bug.

BUT i found a strange solution.
If i deactivated autotune circadian on-off, automation profile change
on-off, now Active show same Value on calc from Fiasp.

Pay attention : above, in the post of fb user on aaps users, she had same
issue but with the latest master.
The master don't have obv autotune inside the app, like the dev.

In the previous version,i have no difference from active to my profiles, in
bolus calc.
